description: This PHP source file defines the RelationshipService class, which manages CRUD operations related to object relationships in a REST API context for the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods to get, create, relate by link, and delete relationships between beans/entities, utilizing helper classes and integrating with the REST API response formats.

classes.name: RelationshipService
classes.description: A service class handling REST API operations for managing relationships between entities (beans) in SuiteCRM, including retrieval, creation, linking, and deletion of relationships.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves related beans for a source bean with pagination and filtering support, returning a structured API response with data, links, and metadata.

methods.name: createRelationship
methods.description: Creates a relationship between two beans and returns a confirmation response.

methods.name: createRelationshipByLink
methods.description: Creates a linked relationship between a source and a related bean, including translation of module labels and detailed response metadata.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Removes a specified relationship between source and related beans, with error handling when the relationship does not exist.
